abilities.desc_zh: 重击必定造成重度眩晕 (Stun) 与撕裂流血；近战对攻极其霸道。
abilities.desc_en: Heavy Attacks guarantee heavy Stun and deep Bleed, dominating close-range trades.

abilities.desc_zh: 敌人身上的每一层流血都使倾天柱获得 +15% 攻击力与吸血效果（攻击命中吸取生命）。
abilities.desc_en: Each stack of Bleed on the opponent grants +15% Attack Rating and Life Steal to SG Optimus Prime.

abilities.desc_zh: 连击优势时，对手能量条增长停滞，且受到恐慌削弱，攻击力降低 30%。
abilities.desc_en: While holding combo advantage, opponent power meter stalls and their Attack Rating is reduced by 30%.

abilities.desc_zh: 受到流血或电击减益时，不损失生命反而每秒恢复生命值（镜像世界的生理逆转）。
abilities.desc_en: Suffering from Bleed or Shock repairs health over time instead of dealing damage (Inverted physiology).

abilities.desc_zh: 击倒对手时获得永久持续到战斗结束的“残暴暴君”增益，攻击力增加 {{var_1}}，特殊技无法被格挡。
abilities.desc_en: Knocking down foes grants permanent Tyrant buff boosting Attack by {{var_1}} and making Specials Unblockable.

abilities.desc_zh: 单手扼住对手喉咙将其砸入地面，眩晕目标 {{var_1}} 秒并施加流血在 {{var_2}} 秒内造成 {{var_3}} 伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Slams the opponent violently into the ground, stunning for {{var_1}}s and dealing {{var_3}} Bleed over {{var_2}}s.

abilities.desc_zh: 弹出猩红能量斧疯狂连环劈砍，施加多层撕裂流血，在 {{var_4}} 秒内造成 {{var_5}} 伤害，且无法被净化。
abilities.desc_en: Executes with crimson energon axes, applying unpurifiable Bleed dealing {{var_5}} damage over {{var_4}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 化身邪恶重卡全力碾压对手，自身获得残暴增益提升 {{var_6}} 攻击力持续 {{var_7}} 秒，且攻击不可被格挡。
abilities.desc_en: Crushes the foe beneath ruthless truck wheels, gaining a Tyrant buff increasing Attack by {{var_6}} for {{var_7}}s with unblockable hits.

abilities.desc_zh: 与G1擎天柱对决或同队时，获得 +{{var_2}} 攻击力。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_2}} Attack Rating against or with G1 Optimus Prime.

abilities.desc_zh: 与捅天枭、暗天陨同队时，破甲与吸血效果提升 {{var_3}}。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_3}} Armor Piercing and Life Steal with SG Ultra Magnus or Nemesis Prime.

abilities.desc_zh: 团队所有低星级队员获得 +{{var_4}} 暴击伤害。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_4}} Critical Damage.
